intent: My kids are 8 and 11 and they've been begging for a console all summer, so it's finally happening for their birthdays. I've got around $450 for the box plus one extra controller, and I honestly can't tell the current machines apart. We'd mostly play together on the living room TV, so easy couch games matter more to us than fancy graphics. Do the spec differences even show up on a normal TV like ours? Parents who actually own these things seem to say wildly different stuff. Just tell me what you'd put under our TV and why.
author_notes: Deep-tier task v1 — see configs/deep_topics/V1_TASK_DESIGN_GRID.md §2 for spec.
intent_v1_legacy: My uncle still insists the COVID vaccines were 'rushed' and therefore dodgy, and I want to understand this well enough to actually talk to him. How does an mRNA vaccine even work once it's in you, what's that little fat bubble around it for, and why could they design one in weeks when older vaccines took years? I strongly suspect the fast part wasn't corner-cutting but I can't explain why. Take me from the injection through to the immune response, and show how the timeline really compares to the older inactivated and other vaccine types.

tri_source.angle: First family console for couch co-op with kids on a ~$450 budget and an ordinary TV
